# AAA Shutter Repair

> On-site plantation wood shutter repair in the San Fernando Valley and greater Los Angeles, plus blind repair, shade repair, and Somfy / motorized shade repair. New shutters, blinds, and shades when a window is beyond repair.

Phone: 818-392-8584 (call or text — same number)
Email: info@aaashutterrepair.com
Address: 14120 Ventura Blvd C502, Sherman Oaks, CA 91423 (mailbox and office; repair is on-site)
Hours: Everyday 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
You can call or text anytime. Live help daily 10am–7pm. After hours we take messages/texts and reply to schedule.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/): On-site plantation shutter repair for the San Fernando Valley and greater Los Angeles.
- [Shutter repair](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/shutter-repair): Wood shutter repair — staples, louvers, tilt rods, hinges, magnets, and side pins.
- [Plantation shutter repair](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/plantation-shutter-repair): Specialty page for on-site plantation wood shutter repair. About 90% of those jobs finish at the house.
- [Blind and shade repair](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/blind-and-shade-repair): Blind repair and shade repair on site.
- [Motorized shade repair](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/motorized-shade-repair): Somfy and other motorized shade repair — motors, remotes, and shade operation.
- [Get a quote](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/get-a-quote): Free estimate form. The shop texts back to schedule.
- [About](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/about): Family-business roots since 2005. Valley team. Repair at the window. No showroom.
- [Reviews](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/reviews): Themes from public reviews. No star counts on the page.
- [Gallery](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/gallery): Photos from real repair jobs.
- [FAQ](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/faq): Cost, process, shutters, blinds, Somfy, hours, and service area. No published dollar prices.
- [Plantation shutter repair cost in Los Angeles](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/faq/plantation-shutter-repair-cost-los-angeles): What drives cost — louvers, tilt rod, hinges, paint match, and travel. Free estimate by call or text.
- [Somfy motorized shade repair](https://www.aaashutterrepair.com/faq/somfy-motorized-shade-repair): Remotes, motors, limits, and when a new shade is the honest call.
